review_locator: PMCID:PMC7140660, On the TRAIL of Better Therapies: Understanding TNFRSF Structure-Function; PMCID:PMC4558505, DED or alive
primary_title: The structure of the death receptor 4-TNF-related apoptosis-inducing ligand (DR4-TRAIL) complex
decision_basis: The reviews identify DR4/TNFRSF10A as a signaling TRAIL receptor; the cited primary study solves the human TRAIL-DR4 complex and measures receptor-binding thermodynamics.
limitations_preserved: Preserve trimeric TRAIL and human DR4 ectodomain/solution-binding context; no universal DISC adaptor or CNS/SCI claim.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC7140660, On the TRAIL of Better Therapies: Understanding TNFRSF Structure-Function; PMCID:PMC4558505, DED or alive
primary_title: Structure of the TRAIL-DR5 complex reveals mechanisms conferring specificity in apoptotic initiation
decision_basis: The reviews identify DR5/TNFRSF10B as a signaling TRAIL receptor; the cited primary study solves the TRAIL-DR5 extracellular complex and defines receptor specificity.
limitations_preserved: Preserve trimeric TRAIL, DR5 receptor clustering and death-receptor context; no CNS/SCI apoptosis inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4558505, DED or alive: assembly and regulation of death effector domain complexes; PMCID:PMC7140660, TNFRSF structure-function review
primary_title: Characterization of Fas (Apo-1, CD95)-Fas ligand interaction; Identification of amino acid residues important for ligand binding to Fas
decision_basis: The reviews identify FasL-FAS/CD95 as a death-receptor ligand pair; the cited primary studies map FasL residues required for Fas binding and connect binding-defective mutants to Fas-positive-cell cytotoxicity.
limitations_preserved: Preserve membrane/cross-linked FasL, species-dependent mutant behavior and Fas death-receptor context; no universal FADD/caspase sequence or CNS/SCI claim.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3727708, How RANKL binds to RANK, and how OPG acts as decoy; PMCID:PMC3607351, RANKL employs distinct binding modes
primary_title: Structure-based development of a RANKL inhibitor peptide and molecular basis for osteopetrosis; RANKL employs distinct binding modes to engage RANK and the OPG decoy receptor
decision_basis: The reviews describe OPG as the soluble RANKL decoy; the cited primary structures and mutagenesis demonstrate the RANKL-OPG complex and overlapping receptor-binding mode.
limitations_preserved: Preserve OPG soluble-decoy topology and RANKL trimer; inhibitory sequestration is not productive RANK signaling and no CNS/SCI claim is made.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC8634938, IL-22 Binding Protein in the Regulation of IL-22 Biology; PMCID:PMC4489423, Molecular Basis of IL-10 Function
primary_title: Crystal structure of a soluble decoy receptor IL-22BP bound to interleukin-22; Cloning and characterization of IL-22 binding protein; A soluble class II cytokine receptor, IL-22RA2, is a naturally occurring IL-22 antagonist
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-22BP/IL22RA2 as a soluble IL-22 decoy; the cited primary studies demonstrate direct binding, overlapping receptor-binding surface, blockade of functional-complex assembly and neutralization of IL-22 activity.
limitations_preserved: Preserve soluble IL-22BP isoform/decoy topology and antagonistic function; do not treat IL22RA2 as a signaling receptor or infer CNS/SCI specificity.
